content.text:
I fixed this in `packages/runtime-core/src/helpers/renderList.ts`. `v-for` now leaves the items of a `shallowReactive` array alone, so `item.aaa` stays a ref and the template shows "object object", as the issue expects.

The bug came from a change in 3.5: when `v-for` loops over a reactive array, it reads the raw items and wraps each one with `toReactive`. It did this for shallow reactive arrays too. That made each item fully reactive, which unwraps nested refs like `aaa` into plain strings. The fix only wraps items when the array is not shallow, using an `isShallow(source)` check. Deep reactive arrays behave exactly as before.

The existing `renderList` tests pass (7/7). I didn't add a test for this case and didn't run the issue's reproduction, so the shallow-array behaviour itself hasn't been checked by a test yet.
